summary: License-plate recognition (LPR/ALPR): a new detection rule mode (detectionType: "lpr") that runs a dedicated second-stage plate-detector + OCR on a high-resolution standalone frame (default 1920 px wide) captured only for cameras that have an active LPR rule. Three watchlist match modes are supported: any (log every readable plate), include (alert on specific plates — VIP/fleet/family), and exclude (alert on any plate not on an allowed list). Fuzzy watchlist matching (Levenshtein ≤ 1) absorbs common single-character OCR errors (O/0, I/1, B/8). The plate text, vehicle type, color, OCR confidence, and watchlist flag are promoted to top-level alert metadata and surface in notification templates ({{plate}}, {{vehicleType}}, {{color}}, {{watchlisted}}), the webhook/MQTT data map, and Telegram message bodies. The plate-detector model (a separate slot from the stock/custom general model, stored as lpr_model.txt) is managed from Settings → AI: operators can pick from a curated catalog of YOLOv11 plate finetunes (morsetechlab, Hugging Face), paste an https URL, or upload a custom .pt. OCR is provided by easyocr, installable in-app without a GPU via POST /api/training/lpr-model/install-deps. Per-camera LPR capability (minimum resolution check + ONVIF auto-pick of the highest-resolution stream) is exposed at GET /api/cameras/{id}/lpr-capability and cached 15 minutes. A background alert-log retention job (configurable via vision.diagnosticRetentionDays / alertRetentionDays / alertPurgeIntervalHours) and a POST /api/vision/alerts/purge endpoint handle alert-table hygiene. The noisy per-frame sampled heartbeat diagnostic is now off by default (vision.persistSampledDiagnostics). Outbound notification delivery (webhook/Telegram/MQTT) now retries transient failures with a 1 s → 3 s → 6 s backoff so cold-start events are not silently dropped; MQTT also waits for the initial broker connect before the first publish.
compatibility: Backward compatible. LPR is a new rule mode — no existing rules are affected. The plate-detector slot starts empty (LPR OCR never runs) until an operator configures a plate model. Alert-log retention purging is disabled by default (diagnosticRetentionDays=0, alertRetentionDays=0). The sampled-diagnostic suppression (persistSampledDiagnostics default false) is a new default; existing installs that relied on sampled diagnostics to confirm the monitor is alive should set vision.persistSampledDiagnostics=true in config.json. Notification retry backoff is transparent to operators — delivery becomes more reliable with no config change required.
